title: 17 July 1961: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
content:
This was The Beatles’ 15th lunchtime performance at the Cavern Club on Liverpool’s Mathew Street.

The group’s lunchtime shows in the cellar club typically lasted from 12-2pm.

Although the precise number of their Cavern performances is not known, The Beatles played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.
